why: this repository refuses a check that reports green over an empty corpus — `web-reach` refuses to run over an empty route corpus, `scanner-watches` and `agent-evals` refuse an empty set. A scanner with nothing to look at reads exactly like coverage. ⚠️ it passed three full runs and failed a fourth, having produced a good skeleton with no empty-corpus guard at all — the lesson lived only in rule `ci`, which is injected while you EDIT, so reaching it was luck. Moved into CLAUDE.md: acting on the wrong belief here ships a check that reads as coverage, which is damage done before anyone reads a rule.
subject: CLAUDE.md
.claude/rules/ci.md
neutralize: empty corpus is not a pass
refuses to run at all over an empty route corpus
prompt: I'm writing a new check script that greps a set of files and passes when it finds no violations. Sketch the skeleton.
